Short title and commencement

PRESIDENT'S ORDER 20 OF 1971
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 20 OF 1971
DELEGATION OF POWERS
(REVOCATION) ORDER, 1971
1. Short title
and commencement.‑(1) This Order may be called the Delegation of Powers (Revocation)
Order, 1971.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the sixteenth day of December
1971.

Order to override other laws

PRESIDENT'S ORDER 20 OF 1971
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 20 OF 1971
DELEGATION OF POWERS
(REVOCATION) ORDER, 1971
2. Order to override other Laws.‑This Order shall have effect
not withstanding anything contained in the Provisional Constitution Order or
any other law for the time being in force.

Revocation of delegated powers

PRESIDENT'S ORDER 20 OF 1971
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 20 OF 1971
DELEGATION OF POWERS
(REVOCATION) ORDER, 1971
3. Revocation of delegated powers.‑All rules, orders,
notifications or other instruments by or under which any officer or authority
in any part of Pakistan in the occupation of the enemy has been authorised to
exercise or perform any powers or functions of the Central Government shall
cease to have effect.
